inlines.text: Each inner cell is the sum of its row and column values. Count equally likely cells to calculate the required probabilities.

children.prompt: What is the probability of scoring

answer.worked:
Two cells have sum 6: $(4,2)$ and $(3,3)$, where the four-sector spinner result is listed first.

$$\begin{aligned}P(6)&=\frac{2}{12}\\&=\frac{1}{6}\end{aligned}$$

Two cells have sum 6 and one cell has sum 7.

$$\begin{aligned}P(6\text{ or }7)&=\frac{1}{6}+\frac{1}{12}\\&=\frac{3}{12}\\&=\frac{1}{4}\end{aligned}$$
